description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kiribathkumbura, Yatinuwara D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320552 (23/1007)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters, specifically the determination of land ownership and registration details for multiple parcels of land in various locations. It contains detailed schedules with land parcel numbers, extents, owner information, and title classifications under the Registration of Title Act. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazette category as it focuses on land registration, property ownership determinations, and title settlement matters.
